fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. The main access driveway runs straight from Commerce Blvd into the property with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. The trailer yard along the west side is open to the property road; perimeter is a grassy berm and trees, no security fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere on the property. Entrance from Street View shows an open driveway directly to the building forecourt with employee parking — no gatehouse structure.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock face along the east side of the building with trailers backed into doors visible in tight imagery. Counted ~50+; band 50+. Exact count uncertain due to trailers obscuring some doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard along the west side of the building — dense rows of angled drop trailers (90+ trailers visible in imagery), clearly a dedicated trailer-storage lot.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide internal paved apron between the dock face and the drop yard provides ample post-entry queue/staging room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in the Rogers MN industrial park on the NW edge of the Twin Cities metro, adjacent to undeveloped wooded/wetland land and a retention pond. Edge-of-metro small-industrial setting; classified Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in overhead imagery.
